name: tiqtoq-instant-game-studio
description: Three instant-win demo games and their database-free local server

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@tiqtoq/game-server && npm run build --workspace=@tiqtoq/game-studio
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@tiqtoq/game-server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@tiqtoq/game-studio
scripts.format: prettier apps scripts tests docs README.md package.json --write
scripts.format:check: prettier apps scripts tests docs README.md package.json --check
